dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: How have what things been... Oh, you mean my work here?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well, we've been dealing with various issues for people whose livelihoods have been affected by the war... I doubt you'd be enthused to hear about such dry stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Nonetheless, I'm doing pretty alright. Thanks for your concern.
